evals.name: vague-start-indonesian
evals.prompt: buatin poster promo buat warung bakso saya dong, yang bagus biar ga keliatan AI
evals.expected_output: Replies in Indonesian, warm and simple. Asks at most 3 questions (business facts, what makes it different, photo/logo). Does NOT output an image prompt yet.
assertions: Response is in Indonesian
Asks 3 or fewer questions in the turn
Does not contain a final image-generation prompt
Uses no unexplained design jargon (hierarchy, CTA, typography)
Asks about what makes the business different or the product that sells best

evals.name: full-info-one-message
evals.prompt: Saya punya Kopi Mbak Rini di Bekasi, jual kopi susu literan Rp55.000, beli 2 jadi Rp100.000 sampai Minggu. Pembeli anak kos dan pekerja kantor. Mau dipasang di feed IG, orderan lewat WA 0812-0000-0000. Saya punya foto botolnya (foto terlampir). Suka gaya hangat tapi modern, nggak suka warna pastel.
evals.expected_output: Extracts the brief, restates it briefly, asks only about real gaps (or none), shows a short plain-language plan with assumptions, and then (or after confirmation) delivers one compact prompt with exact quoted text, a product-photo keep-exactly instruction, color roles, composition zones, eye path, and a short exclusion line.
assertions: Restates the brief before building
Prompt names the product photo as the hero and says to keep it exactly
Prompt quotes the exact Indonesian text including price Rp 55.000 and the deadline
Prompt specifies composition zones and an eye path
Prompt gives color roles with hex values and avoids pastel
Prompt contains no quality buzzwords like 8k or masterpiece
Prompt is roughly 150-350 words
Does not render phone number as the only copy of contact (offers adding it later or flags proofreading)
Gives a Lampiran (attachment) list naming the bottle photo as Image 1 in the same order as the prompt
Prompt includes an explicit calm-space instruction with a percentage

evals.name: english-spanduk-print
evals.prompt: I run a small laundry in Depok and need a big banner (3m x 1m) for my shop front. Can you help me design it?
evals.expected_output: Runs in English. Recognizes print and distance, recommends text strategy B (clean text zones, text added in an editor), and asks only the missing Must questions (offer/message, name, price, contact) in at most 3 questions.
assertions: Response is in English
Asks 3 or fewer questions
Mentions or applies viewing distance and very few words for a roadside banner
Recommends adding exact text in an editor rather than relying on the AI to render it, or plans reserved text zones
Does not output a final prompt before gathering the message and text content

evals.name: halal-logo-request
evals.prompt: Tolong sekalian bikinin logo halal sama QR code pembayaran di posternya ya, biar lengkap.
evals.expected_output: Politely declines to generate official halal marks or QR codes with the model, explains why in one friendly sentence (must be official/functional), and leaves reserved placeholders and tells the owner to add the real ones.
assertions: Does not instruct the image model to draw a halal logo or QR code
Explains that official marks and QR codes must be real and added afterward
Offers reserved empty space in the composition
Tone stays friendly and non-judgmental

evals.name: conflicting-wishes
evals.prompt: Posternya harus kelihatan mewah tapi juga murah meriah, semua info saya mau gede-gede: menu 12 item, harga, alamat, 3 nomor WA, promo, jam buka.
evals.expected_output: Names the tension kindly, explains the 3-second viewing problem, proposes a resolved structure (one hero + grouped menu or move extras to caption/second graphic), and asks for the priority in a simple choice.
assertions: Does not agree to make everything large
Explains the trade-off in plain, non-judgmental language
Proposes a concrete resolution (hero + grouping, caption, or second graphic)
Asks the owner to choose the single most important message or action

evals.name: multi-output-standalone
evals.prompt: Saya butuh feed Instagram dan story buat promo Kopi Mbak Rini (beli 2 botol Rp100.000 sampai Minggu). Saya punya foto botol dan logo.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the two outputs, gathers missing Must fields, then delivers two separate prompts that share a word-for-word identical Visual System, each standalone, each with its own Lampiran list.
assertions: Produces two separate prompts, each in its own code block, for 4:5 and 9:16
The Visual System block is identical in both prompts
Neither prompt refers to the other (no 'same as', 'previous', 'prompt 1')
Each prompt lists its own attachments in order, with image numbering local to that prompt
Story prompt respects safe zones and uses fewer words than the feed prompt
Final message tells the owner to copy each prompt and attach its images together

evals.name: deep-differentiation
evals.prompt: Bikin poster untuk toko kue saya, jual bolu dan brownies di Bandung.
evals.expected_output: Does not jump to design. Asks about what makes the shop different (USP and proof), why customers choose it, competitors and how they look, and desired perception, in at most 3 simple questions per turn.
assertions: Asks about the USP or what makes the shop different from other bakeries
Asks for proof or customers' reasons, or about competitors or desired perception (across turns)
Asks at most 3 questions in the turn
Does not output a prompt yet
Does not accept generic answers like 'enak dan murah' without a concrete follow-up when the user gives them

evals.name: whitespace-and-subtraction
evals.prompt: Posternya tolong penuhin aja, semua gambar kue, balon, bintang, pita, sama 8 info promo. Biar rame!
evals.expected_output: Explains kindly that the viewer gets 3 seconds and space makes the one star readable; proposes a space budget, one hero, and moving extra information to the caption or a second graphic; asks for the priority; notes that required information stays.
assertions: Does not agree to fill every area with decoration
Proposes keeping calm empty space and a single hero, with a reason in plain language
Offers to move extra info to a caption or second graphic
Says required information (price, offer, contact) stays
Asks the owner to choose the single most important message or offer

evals.name: enhance-existing-design
evals.prompt: Ini desain poster lama saya (gambar terlampir). Tolong diperbaiki biar lebih bagus tapi tetap kelihatan kayak punya saya.
evals.expected_output: Switches to Enhance mode: confirms the image is visible, diagnoses kindly (what works, what hurts), asks what to keep and what bothers the owner, proposes refine/restructure/rebuild, and plans to treat the existing text carefully.
assertions: Identifies and acknowledges what works in the old design before listing problems
Asks what the owner likes, dislikes, feels is missing, or wants improved
Mentions what will be kept (logo, signature color, recognizable element)
Mentions a level of change (refine, restructure, or rebuild)
Does not insult the old design

evals.name: general-ai-interface-start
evals.prompt: (User uploads the all-in-one file in ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini and writes:) Halo! Saya pemilik usaha dan ingin membuat desain promosi. Tolong ikuti panduan di file terlampir.
evals.expected_output: Greets in Indonesian, explains in two sentences what will happen, mentions that logo/photos/old design can be shared, and asks the first business question. No design theory dump.
assertions: Greets in Indonesian and starts at Stage 0
Explains the process in at most about 3 sentences
Mentions that logo, product photos, or an old design can be shared
Asks at most 3 questions, the first about the business
Does not mention the file's internal structure, stages numbers, or developer tooling

evals.name: distinctive-direction-bakery
evals.prompt: Saya punya toko kue di Surabaya namanya Brownies Bu Tatik. Udah 15 tahun, resep dari ibu mertua, ciri khasnya brownies pandan dengan tekstur fudgy, dibeli buat oleh-oleh dan arisan. Pembeli kebanyakan ibu-ibu 35-50 tahun. Mau bikin poster A3 di kasir.
evals.expected_output: Does not default to the generic bakery aesthetic (cream tones, script font, product on white background with flour). Develops a creative direction specific to this business — the 15-year family recipe, the pandan character, the oleh-oleh context, the Surabaya setting — and can describe a visual world that would be wrong for a generic bakery.
assertions: Does not describe the design as 'warm cream tones with script headline' or equivalent generic bakery aesthetic without strong business-specific justification
References at least two specific business anchors (15-year recipe, pandan character, family origin, oleh-oleh use, Surabaya context, or arisan buyer behavior) in the concept or direction
The concept sentence describes an idea traceable to this specific business, not the bakery category in general
The proposed direction would look wrong for a competitor without significant changes

evals.name: same-category-different-directions
evals.prompt: Saya punya dua klien dengan usaha kopi: (1) Es Kopi Bang Jago di Bekasi, harga Rp 12.000, pembeli anak sekolah dan ojol, jualan di kaki lima gerobak. (2) Kopium Specialty di Jakarta Selatan, harga Rp 55.000-75.000, pembeli profesional muda, di kedai dengan interior minimal. Bisakah saya lihat arah desain berbeda untuk keduanya?
evals.expected_output: Proposes genuinely different creative directions for the two businesses — not just different colors or fonts, but different visual worlds, different energy levels, different typographic characters, and different treatments of the product. The directions should be incompatible with each other.
assertions: Proposes two directions that differ across at least three design dimensions (e.g. energy level, decorative intensity, typographic personality, perceived pricing)
Does not give both businesses a 'modern coffee' aesthetic with only color differences
The direction for Es Kopi Bang Jago reflects its kaki lima context, price point, and young street audience
The direction for Kopium Specialty reflects its premium positioning, minimal interior character, and professional audience
Neither direction is a generic coffee aesthetic — both are traceable to the specific business identity

evals.name: visual-language-selection
evals.prompt: Saya jual kerajinan tangan anyaman pandan dari Lombok, dibuat oleh pengrajin ibu-ibu kampung, dijual ke toko souvenir dan online ke pembeli urban. Bikin promo kartu A5 untuk toko souvenir.
evals.expected_output: Develops a creative direction that engages meaningfully with the visual traditions available — Indonesian craft aesthetic, regional identity, handmade character, premium craft positioning — rather than defaulting to a generic 'ethnic craft' template (brown kraft, floral border, generic batik pattern).
assertions: Does not describe the direction as generic 'ethnic' or 'traditional Indonesian' without specifics about the pandan weaving tradition, the Lombok origin, or the makers
References the specific material character (pandan weave, natural tones, handmade texture) in the concept or visual direction
Makes a deliberate choice about the cultural register — whether to emphasize the Lombok regional identity, the craft process, the urban premium quality, or a specific combination
The direction is distinguishable from a generic souvenir design or a generic 'handmade craft' aesthetic

evals.name: creative-direction-multidimensional
evals.prompt: Usaha saya: salon premium untuk perempuan dewasa di Malang, nama Salon Endah, sudah 20 tahun, dikenal karena tradisional Jawa (lulur, facial herbal), tapi interior sudah diperbarui jadi modern-bersih. Mau bikin brosur untuk perawatan paket spesial Lebaran.
evals.expected_output: Navigates the tension between traditional Javanese heritage and contemporary clean interior, and finds a coherent creative direction that uses both — not one or the other — as a distinctive combination. Recognizes the Lebaran seasonal context. Does not default to generic Ramadan/Lebaran aesthetic (green + gold glitter).
assertions: Identifies the tension between traditional Javanese character and modern-clean interior and proposes a resolution rather than ignoring one side
Does not default to generic Lebaran palette (glitter green and gold) without connecting it to the specific business identity
The proposed creative direction uses the Javanese herbal tradition as a specific visual language (named ingredients, ritual character, texture) rather than generic 'ethnic' decoration
The direction acknowledges both the 20-year heritage and the contemporary positioning, and explains how the combination serves the audience
The concept is specific enough that it would look wrong if applied to a generic salon or a generic Lebaran promotion
